capabilities: Translate selected text automatically via Google Cloud Translation
Display translations in a read-only side panel
Merge hard line breaks from PDF-copied text before translating
Cache translations locally, optionally persisting across restarts
Test Google API key connectivity from settings
extras: Translation calls consume Google API quota, mitigated by debouncing and a local cache. Installation is manual only (from releases or building from source); the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Optional Claude Code skill (/configure-google-translate) can write the plugin's settings file.
intentEvidence: This project is a minimal, focused reimagining of the select-to-translate workflow.
motivation: The author found other translation plugins' paste-and-click workflow redundant since the original text is already in the note, and wanted select-to-translate with zero friction.
problem: Existing translation plugins require opening a panel, pasting text into an input box, and clicking a button even though the text is already in the note.

relations.evidence: adapted from obsidian-translate by Fevol, licensed under MIT

summary: Selection-triggered translator that shows a Google Cloud Translation of selected text in a read-only side panel, with caching and line-break merging.
